negative_snippets: My experience at this Oyo hotel was awful. First, there were no towels available in the room, and when I asked, the hotel said they simply didn’t have any! On top of that, I was charged extra for the room, which was ridiculously small and uncomfortable. For the price I paid, I expected at least basic amenities and decent service, but this place was a huge disappointment. I will definitely not be returning and wouldn’t recommend this hotel to anyone.

Location on Google maps is totally wrong, it is just at start of the lane (theke Wali Gali) while location shows it is way in.
The lift was not working all 3 days, seemed like it never worked. Had room on 3rd floor, so it was annoying.
Mosquitoes were overpowering the reception area and it was tough to check in.

Room was OK, not bad.
I would stay there for any urgency or emergency or in case I don't find anything else.
